text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Thursday.
- Croatian oil company INA: There will be no shortage of oil products.
- The visit to Albania was successful, claims the Prime Minister Zlatko Matesa.
- British magazine Foreign report's unnamed author, helped by Serb advisors, accusses Croatia of violating human rights.
- What does the Boeing package for Croatia contain?
- New elections would not resolve the crisis, says the president of the Zagreb city assembly, Zdravko Tomac.
- Radio 101 between a rock and a hard place after the decision by the city assembly not to increase its capital.
- The house or representatives passes the media bill.
- Why are the deputies not attending parliament sessions: Is absence a means of political struggle? -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
